scenes.text: The world's greatest escape artist died on Halloween, exactly one hundred years ago this week.
Harry Houdini passed away in Detroit on October thirty first, nineteen twenty six.
Before he died, he made his wife Bess a promise: he would try to contact her from beyond the grave.
They agreed on a secret code, starting with the word Rosabelle, so no fake psychic could cheat.
Bess held a séance every Halloween for ten years, but the code never came.
After the last one in nineteen thirty six, she said her last hope was gone.
Fans still hold Houdini séances every Halloween. Would you go to one?

title: Houdini promised to escape death itself 🎩
caption: Harry Houdini died on Halloween 1926, 100 years ago this week. He gave his wife Bess a secret code to prove any message from beyond was really him. She waited 10 Halloweens. 🎩
